name: maybe_Field_Actor_UpdateModelActionState
summary: Per-frame actor update: ticks the scene node children, and when the actor is not flagged at +0x51 but has +0xBC set and its model reports the action finished (0x00669DD4), dispatches actor vtable +0x40 with state 4 to return the actor to its idle state.
evidence: Body is void: it calls Field_SceneNode_TickChildren, tests byte +0x51 and +0xBC, calls 0x00669DD4, then invokes vtable slot +0x40 with argument 4 and returns. The 0x00669DD4 result is consumed by the branch, so no dropped return value is involved; the function performs a state dispatch, not a predicate, hence the rename away from Check*. Only one caller (a field scene spawn helper) and no strings/constants, so confidence stays below 0.5.
